'''2001 New South Wales State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Sydney, Australia on 20 May 2001. [[Clarrie Brown]] won it. It is known from Luke Bartter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2362">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-23-nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01d2362/ nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01], DeckTech (Luke "Like" Bartter, 23 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-23-nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01d2362/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Clarrie Brown]]
